subject: Request: temporary Net-75 & quarterly invoicing — Greenbridge Health
messages:
From: Ana Torres <ana.torres@greenbridgehealth.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@greenbridgehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: temporary Net-75 & quarterly invoicing — Greenbridge Health

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — Marcus and I came away excited about Redwood for our clinical insights pipeline. We have a procurement constraint on our end: our finance team only issues vendor payments on a quarterly cadence, and our CFO prefers a 75-day payment window for pilot vendors (Net-75) before moving to standard Net-30 once governance is established.

Two asks from Greenbridge:
- Can Redwood accept quarterly invoicing (single invoice per quarter) for the pilot?
- Can you approve Net-75 for the first two quarters, with the option to revert to Net-30 after a successful pilot review?

We understand this is non-standard. If helpful, we can provide a purchase order and a short amendment. We are proposing a small up-front engagement fee (25% of first-quarter estimate) to reduce your exposure; we can make that prepayment immediately upon contract signature.

Attached: summary of our Q2 cash projection and the PO template.

Appreciate your help — happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

Best,
Ana Torres
Sr. Procurement Manager | Greenbridge Health
Attachments: Greenbridge-Q2-projection.xlsx; PO-Greenbridge-GB4721.pdf

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary Net-75 & quarterly invoicing — Greenbridge Health

Team — forwarding Greenbridge's ask. Key points: they want quarterly invoicing + Net-75 for first two quarters, offering 25% up-front for the first quarter. Deal size: pilot $180k ARR run-rate estimate (see attached summary).

Why this matters: Greenbridge is an early enterprise prospect in our healthcare vertical and could expand quickly if pilot succeeds. Risk: Net-75 and quarterly invoicing exposure for our cash flow.

Suggested path: request conditional approval from deal desk/finance with a requirement for a prepayment and a short-term credit check. Can you advise next steps and whether we need exec signoff for >60-day terms?

Thanks — Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Account Executive, Healthcare
Redwood Inference
Attachments: deal-summary-RWI-7845.xlsx

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 13:28:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary Net-75 & quarterly invoicing — Greenbridge Health

Dylan — thanks for the context. A few things from finance:
1) Net-75 is outside our standard T&Cs and requires exec approval because it impacts DSO and cash reserves.
2) We should require the 25% up-front payment Ana offered AND a secondary milestone payment (50%) on go-live/acceptance, with the remaining 25% invoiced per their quarterly cadence.
3) Please request a formal credit package: P&L/BS or our standard credit questionnaire. We also need the PO and a billed-to legal name for the amendment.

If they can provide the prepay and the PO, finance is comfortable recommending a conditional approval to Sales Leadership. Marissa — could you own the amendment language (short-term billing bridge + revert to Net-30 after 2 quarters)?

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments requested: credit-report-greenbridge.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary Net-75 & quarterly invoicing — Greenbridge Health

Agree with Evelyn. Draft amendment approach (summary):
- Term: Pilot amendment for 6 months tied to deal RWI-7845.
- Billing: Redwood will send a single consolidated invoice at the end of each quarter.
- Payment schedule: 25% prepayment upon signature; 50% milestone payment due on go-live acceptance (defined in SOW); remaining 25% due within 75 days of invoice date (Net-75).
- Reversion: On successful pilot review (end of Q2 after go-live), billing terms will migrate to standard Net-30 for subsequent billing cycles.
- Security: require PO and confirmation of billing entity; finance to perform a light credit check.

I'll prepare the amendment doc and mark as "pilot billing bridge". If Sales Leadership approves, we'll send DocuSign.

Marissa Cole
Senior Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Greenbridge-Term-Amendment-v1.pdf (draft)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com, dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 14:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary Net-75 & quarterly invoicing — Greenbridge Health

Thanks — I reviewed the proposal and supporting docs. Executive consent (conditional): APPROVE Net-75 for the first two quarters under the following conditions:
- 25% of Q1 invoice paid as prepayment at signature (non-refundable, applied to Q1).
- 50% of Q1 due on go-live acceptance (explicit acceptance criteria in SOW).
- Remaining 25% invoiced per their quarterly cycle and due Net-75.
- Amendment must include a clause to automatically revert to Net-30 after the two-quarter pilot unless mutually extended in writing.
- Deal desk to obtain PO and the requested credit documentation prior to signature.

Operational notes: Marissa, please finalize amendment and loop Legal for a quick pass. Finance — confirm risk is acceptable with these protections. Dylan — once DocuSign is ready, send to Ana and Marcus and request PO.

Jonas Weber
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ana Torres <ana.torres@greenbridgehealth.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@greenbridgehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary Net-75 & quarterly invoicing — Greenbridge Health

Ana / Marcus — great news: leadership has given conditional approval to proceed with the pilot billing bridge. Summary of agreed approach (please confirm):
- We will execute a short amendment to your Master Services Agreement that implements a pilot billing bridge for two quarters.
- Payment schedule for Q1: 25% prepayment on signature (you confirmed you can do this), 50% on go-live acceptance, 25% invoiced and collected on a Net-75 basis.
- After two quarters, billing terms will revert to Net-30 unless both parties agree to extend in writing.

Next steps:
1) Marissa will send the DocuSign amendment for signature (link below).
2) Please return the signed amendment and a purchase order with the billed-to legal name.
3) Finance has requested light credit documentation; if you can attach the PO and a brief credit summary we can expedite.

DocuSign (amendment): https://www.docusign.com/txn/abc123-greenbridge-amend
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/328754/company/GB-4721

Happy to schedule a 15-min call if you'd like to walk through the amendment. Thanks for the partnership — excited to get started.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Healthcare | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Greenbridge-Term-Amendment-v1.pdf (attached for reference)
